title: The $50 Million Deal Blockbuster Laughed At (Demo)
description:
DEMO render of the Sneaky Deals long-form engine. Not for publishing.

In 2000, Netflix's founders offered to sell their company to Blockbuster for $50 million. Blockbuster said no. Ten years later it was bankrupt.

⚠️ Dramatised: illustrations and reconstructions; the facts are real.

Sources:
• Marketplace: CEO Reed Hastings on how Netflix beat Blockbuster
• Newsweek fact-check: Did Blockbuster turn down a chance to buy Netflix for $50 million
• CNBC: How Netflix almost lost the movie rental wars to Blockbuster
• Oregon Encyclopedia: Last Blockbuster video store in the U.S.
• Business Insider: The rise and fall of Blockbuster
